name: muesli
description: Analyze supplied muesli transcripts, with optional local CLI workflows on macOS.

interface.longDescription: Turn a muesli transcript you share in chat into notes, decisions, and action items. On a Mac with local command access, use muesli’s CLI to inspect meetings and dictations, transcribe audio, inspect Vidshot frames and narration, or look up activity in Time Turner. ChatGPT can analyze material you share in the conversation; installing this skill does not give it access to your Mac.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this muesli transcript I provided.
Find decisions and action items in this muesli transcript.
On my Mac, list recent muesli meetings with the CLI.

publication.release_notes: Adds local Vidshot inspection by capture, frame, timestamp, or mark. Updates CLI guidance for Time Turner, history sampling, task templates, and model terms. ChatGPT still works with transcripts you supply.
